app.name: e-Himaya · Institutions portal
app.footer: e-Himaya — national emergency-reporting platform of the Civil Protection. In an emergency, call 198.

auth.callbackError: Sign-in did not complete or the request expired. Please try again.

common.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it manually.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link you opened does not exist in the portal.

landing.title: Institutions portal
landing.lead: Register your institution with the Civil Protection, keep its safety file up to date and report emergencies on its behalf.
landing.point1: Institution card, classification and completeness checklist
landing.point2: Safety team, hazardous materials, equipment and on-site map
landing.point3: Versioned documents: safety file, safety plan and safety data sheets
landing.point4: Digital safety certificate, verifiable by anyone
landing.verifyBody: Enter the code printed on the certificate (or scan its QR code) to check whether it is valid. No account is needed.
landing.emergencyBody: This portal does not replace a call. Dial directly:

verify.title: Certificate verification
verify.intro: Check a digital safety certificate issued through e-Himaya.
verify.validBody: This certificate of {{name}} is approved and valid until {{date}}.
verify.invalidBody: This certificate exists but is not valid today:

reasons.rejected: it was rejected by the Civil Protection;
reasons.revoked: it was revoked by the platform auditors after its approval;
reasons.not_approved: it has not been approved yet;
reasons.signature: its electronic signature could not be verified.

verify.notFoundBody: No published certificate has the code {{code}}. Check the code (drafts are never public).
verify.compareBody: Choose or drop the PDF you received: your browser computes its SHA-256 fingerprint and compares it with the registered one. The file never leaves your device.
verify.dropHint: Drag and drop the file here, or choose it.
verify.matchBody: {{name}} is exactly the registered PDF of this certificate.
verify.mismatchBody: {{name}} differs from the registered PDF: it may have been modified, or it is another version of the certificate.
verify.readError: The file {{name}} could not be read.
verify.keyBody: Signature algorithm {{algorithm}}. Signed message: {{message}}. Public key (base64):
verify.keyNone: No public key is published yet.
verify.disclaimer: This certificate is a safety self-assessment recorded by the institution on the e-Himaya platform and reviewed by its auditors. It is not an official certificate of the National Office of Civil Protection or of any other administration, and it does not replace the permits and inspections required by law.

myOrgs.title: My institutions
myOrgs.emptyBody: Register your institution, or open the invitation link an administrator sent you.

register.title: Register an institution

help.identity: Official name, kind and identifier (tax identification number or national business register).
help.building: These figures decide the classification: maximum number of people present, floors and height.
help.location: Click on the map or drag the pin onto the main entrance. The gouvernorat is deduced from the point.
help.contacts: The manager is the person the Civil Protection contacts about the institution.
help.review: Check the information. The registration is reviewed by the Civil Protection before activation.

register.doneBody: {{name}} is pending review by the Civil Protection.
register.doneNext: Meanwhile you can complete the safety team, registers and documents. Reporting on behalf of the institution, invitations and certificate submission open after approval.

org.name: Institution name
org.identifierHintMf: 7 digits and a letter, optionally /letter/letter/3 digits (e.g. 1234567A or 1234567A/A/M/000).
org.capacityHint: Staff and public together, at the busiest time.
org.heightHint: Floor level of the highest storey; above 28 m the building is high-rise.

location.help: Click on the map to place the point, drag the pin to adjust it, or type the coordinates.
location.mapLabel: Map: click to choose the location

validation.identifierMf: Invalid tax identifier: 7 digits and a letter, optionally /letter/letter/3 digits.
validation.identifierRne: Invalid RNE identifier: 7 digits and a letter.
validation.integer: Enter a whole number (0 or more).
validation.integerPositive: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
validation.locationRequired: Choose the location on the map.
validation.outsideTunisia: The location must be in Tunisia.
validation.unNumber: UN number: exactly 4 digits (or leave empty).

workspace.roleRequired: Read only: your role ({{role}}) does not allow this action.
workspace.notActive: Not available while the institution is “{{status}}”.

pending_review.title: Pending review
pending_review.body: The Civil Protection is reviewing the registration. You can already complete the file.

rejected.title: Registration rejected
rejected.body: Fix the card according to the reason below, then resubmit.

suspended.title: Institution suspended
suspended.body: The institution is suspended: its certificates are not valid and it cannot report or invite.

classification.title: Classification
classification.computed: Computed by the platform from the card and the registers; it cannot be typed.
classification.provisional: Provisional classification: the thresholds are a working model that must be validated against the official text (fire, explosion and panic safety code for buildings) with the Civil Protection.

requirements.safety_team: Safety team: a representative and at least one member
requirements.training: Every team member has a training date, none expired
requirements.hazmat_sds: A safety data sheet for every hazardous material
requirements.equipment: At least one equipment item, none overdue
requirements.evacuation_points: At least one evacuation point on the map

kinds.training_expired: Expired training in the safety team
kinds.training_expiring: Training expiring soon in the safety team

card.backToReview: Changing the name or the identifier of an active institution sends it back to review: until it is approved again it cannot report, invite or submit a certificate.
card.conflictHelp: Someone else saved the card meanwhile. Reload the latest version (your unsaved changes will be lost), then apply them again.

team.title: Safety team
team.help: The representative and the members of the internal safety team, with their training.
team.noRepresentative: The team has no representative yet.
team.oneRepresentative: The team already has a representative (one at most).

hazmat.title: Hazardous materials
hazmat.help: Each stored hazardous material needs its safety data sheet (SDS) document.
hazmat.name: Material
hazmat.sdsHint: Documents of kind “Safety data sheet”. Create and upload it in Documents first.

equipment.title: Safety equipment
equipment.help: Fire-fighting and alarm equipment with its maintenance schedule.

features.title: Map of the site
features.help: Evacuation and assembly points, water points and alarms of the institution.
features.helpEdit: Click on the map to add a point (within {{km}} km of the institution), click a point to edit it, drag it to move it.
features.label: Label
features.mapLabel: Map of the institution and its points

documents.help: Each upload adds a new version; the history is kept. The server checks the fingerprint of every file.
documents.newHelp: Create the document, then upload its first version.
documents.title: Title
documents.confirmDelete: Delete the document “{{title}}” and all its versions?
documents.typesPlan: PDF (50 MB) or CAD plan .dwg / .dxf (100 MB).
documents.sent: File sent. The server is verifying it; the version will show “Stored” once checked.

members.title: Members
members.help: People who can access the institution, and their role.
members.name: Name
members.linkBody: Send this link to {{email}} (role: {{role}}). They must sign in with that e-mail address to accept. The link is valid 7 days.
members.linkOnce: This link is shown only once: copy it now.
members.leaveBody: You will lose access to the institution. The last administrator cannot leave.
members.leaveUnavailable: Your membership could not be identified (sign in with the e-mail of your membership).
members.confirmLeave: Leave {{name}}? You will need a new invitation to come back.

roleHelp.admin: everything, plus members, invitations, certificate submission and document deletion
roleHelp.editor: edits the card, team, registers, map and documents; generates a draft certificate
roleHelp.member: reads everything; reports on behalf of the institution and follows its reports

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: You are invited to join {{org}} as {{role}}.
invite.mismatchWarning: You are signed in as {{email}}, but the invitation is for {{invited}}. Sign in with the invited address to accept it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.help: Reports made on behalf of the institution and their follow-up.
reports.emergencyNote: Lives in danger? Call 198 first: a report does not replace a call.
reports.sentBody: The Civil Protection received the report. Keep the tracking code.

charter.title: Charter
charter.why: Before the first report, the platform charter must be accepted.
charter.unknownVersion: The server requires charter version {{version}}, which this portal does not have yet. Reload the page or try later.

2026-10.placeholderNotice: PLACEHOLDER — provisional summary, to be replaced by the official text of the charter.
2026-10.intro: e-Himaya is the national platform for reporting emergencies to the Civil Protection.
2026-10.body: Reports (category, description, location and attachments) and the identity of your account are processed only to handle emergencies, in accordance with Organic Law No. 2004-63 on the protection of personal data, under the supervision of the INPDP. You have the right to access, rectify and object.
2026-10.liability: Knowingly making a false report engages your legal liability.
2026-10.checkbox: I have read and accept the charter, and I understand that a knowingly false report engages my legal liability.

certificate.title: Safety certificate
certificate.help: A draft snapshots the card, the classification, the team, the registers, the map and the current documents. An administrator submits it to the Civil Protection.
certificate.incompleteWarning: The file is incomplete ({{n}} missing items): submission will be refused.
certificate.draftNote: Drafts are not public and carry a “DRAFT” watermark.

errors.realm_not_allowed: This account type cannot use the portal.
errors.org_not_found: Institution not found, or you are not a member.
errors.org_role_required: Your role in the institution does not allow this action.
errors.org_not_active: This action needs an approved (active) institution.

errors.invalid_identifier: The identifier does not have the expected format.

errors.too_many_invitations: Too many pending invitations (20 at most). Revoke some first.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation does not exist, was already used or was revoked.

errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to another e-mail address. Sign in with the invited address.

errors.invalid_document: The chosen safety data sheet is not a document of this institution.
errors.feature_too_far: The point must be within 2 km of the institution.
errors.too_many_features: Too many points on the map (200 at most).
errors.document_in_use: This document is used by a hazardous material: unlink it first.
errors.document_too_large: File too large (50 MB at most, 100 MB for CAD plans).
errors.incomplete: The safety file is incomplete. Missing items:
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.validation_error: Some of the data sent is invalid.
errors.conflict: Conflict with another change. Reload the page.
errors.server_error: Server error. Try again in a moment.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check the network.
errors.certificate_outdated: This draft was generated before the file was complete: generate a new draft, then submit it.
errors.signing_key_missing: The platform cannot sign certificates at the moment. Try again later.
